subject: Backport some v3.0 syntax extensions.
files: doc/extensions.html, Makefile.dep, lj_bc.h, lj_bcdump.h, lj_bcwrite.c, lj_carith.c/.h, lj_crecord.c/.h, lj_dispatch.h, lj_errmsg.h, lj_ffrecord.c, lj_ir.h, lj_lex.c/.h, lj_meta.c/.h, lj_obj.h, lj_opt_fold.c, lj_parse.c, lj_record.c, vm_{arm,arm64,mips,mips64,ppc,x64,x86}.dasc (28 files)
relevance: This is the change the pin exists to exclude: bit operators, !, &&, ||, !=, ?:, ?., ??, compound assignment, continue, const, short functions, 1_000. CC:T/Cobalt reject all of it and upstream has no switch. It also touches lj_record.c, lj_dispatch.h and vm_x64.dasc, which patches 01/07/08 edit.

subject: Document bit operator bytecode compatibility.
relevance: None.

subject: Fix documentation about Lua 5.2 extensions/compatibility.
relevance: None.

subject: DynASM/x86: Fix movd/movq and vmovd/vmovq operand sizes.
relevance: No behaviour change: lj_vm.o built from 14d8a7a2 and from 14d8a7a2+346ab587 is byte-identical (cmp). Taken only so that vm_x64.dasc and dasm_x86.lua stay in sync with upstream, which keeps later x64 VM fixes clean to cherry-pick. Patch 08 also edits vm_x64.dasc; it still applies.

subject: FFI: Fix widening semantics for 64 bit arithmetic.
relevance: lj_crecord.c is FFI code. The fold rule (simplify_conv_i64_num) needs a CONV num.u32 operand, which only FFI produces.

subject: x86: Conditionally use SSE3 for 64 bit conversions.
relevance: 32-bit x86 is not a target (LJ_TARGET_X86 only). Its lj_meta.c hunk edits lj_meta_bitop(), which a2ce8114 added.

subject: x64/LJ_GC64: Enable XLOAD/STRREF fusion.
relevance: Performance only. It introduced a bug that 1edc3e52 fixes.

subject: Optimize common 1-char case of string.sub/string.byte.
relevance: Performance only. s:sub(i,i) and s:byte(i) are common in CC code, so this could help, but nobody has measured it.

subject: FFI: Set cur_L in FFI callback.
relevance: None (FFI is disabled).

subject: Don't fold -a / -b for unsigned operands.
relevance: It only affects u32/u64 DIV IR, and only FFI 64-bit arithmetic emits that.

subject: Modernize jit.* Lua modules.
relevance: The jit.* Lua modules are not shipped, and the sandbox removes jit.

subject: x64/LJ_GC64: Fix XLOAD fusion.
relevance: It fixes only afa81a57. In the base, STRREF fusion is still compiled out under GC64 (`} if (0) {`).

subject: Compile unpack().
relevance: Performance only (unpack/table.unpack is common in CC). It needed two follow-up fixes within a day (21ecb361, 8c23d6aa).

subject: FFI: Mark cts->L in atomic phase.
relevance: The lj_gc.c hunk is inside #if LJ_HASFFI.

subject: Handle OOM error during trace stitching.
relevance: Relevant. The memory cap makes OOM routine, and trace stitching happens around every C function that has no recorder, which includes all host/Java-bridge functions and the C bit32.

subject: Fix next() recording immediately after ITERN despecialization.
relevance: Relevant: pairs()/next() loops are everywhere in the ROM and in user code.

subject: Fix unpack() recording.
relevance: It fixes only 52cdb12e.

subject: Fix unpack() recording.
relevance: It fixes only 52cdb12e.

subject: Add FOLD rule for ALEN of TNEW/TDUP.
relevance: Performance only. The second reproducer in #1534 (fixed by 95f931cb) is a bug in this rule.

subject: FFI: Adjust J->maxslot after ffi.offsetof.
relevance: The hunk is in the LJ_POST_FIXCONST case, which only lj_crecord.c sets.

subject: PPC: Fix string.* fast functions with P64 set (testing only).
relevance: PPC is not a target.

subject: Allow empty statements (semicolons) anywhere. v3.0 backport.
relevance: It makes `return;;` legal. It uses TK_continue from a2ce8114.

subject: DynASM/ARM64: Prevent sanitizer warning in dasm_imm13().
relevance: It fixes UB in buildvm, for ARM64 builds only. It is needed when ARM64 ships and has no effect on x64 builds.

subject: Fix concurrent allocation issue on DragonFly (unsupported).
relevance: DragonFly is not a target.

subject: ARM64: Fix BC_JFORI on empty FP range.
relevance: Needed before ARM64 ships: wrong PC on an empty FP for-range with a compiled loop. Inert on x64.

subject: ARM64: Fix getmetatable() for cleared __metatable field.
relevance: Needed before ARM64 ships. The fast path compared the key instead of the value, so when the __metatable key exists with a nil value, getmetatable returns nil instead of the metatable. That hides the metatable; it does not leak a protected one. Inert on x64.

subject: FFI: Fix recording of string buffer put() method.
category: stdlib fix (string.buffer recorder); despite the "FFI:" prefix it is not FFI-gated
relevance: string.buffer is compiled in (LJ_HASBUFFER=1) but can only be reached through package.preload, which the sandbox removes. One line.

subject: x86: Fix math.floor()/ceil() argument check.
relevance: 32-bit x86 is not a target.

subject: x64: Fix math.floor()/ceil() argument check.
relevance: Relevant, and verified. On 14d8a7a2, pcall(math.floor) returns true, 11 (a stale stack value) on both Windows and Linux; on the branch it raises "bad argument #1". It is a stale-slot read that sandboxed code can trigger. vm_x64.dasc is also patched by 08; no conflict.

subject: Don't record for loops with +-0 step.
relevance: Relevant, and verified. 12 of 96 for-loops with a variable +-0 step give different results under JIT and interpreter on 14d8a7a2; 0 differ on the branch. lj_record.c is also patched by 01; no conflict.

subject: Fix parsing of safe-navigation operator.
relevance: It fixes `?.`, which comes from a2ce8114.

subject: Windows: Use 64 bit conversion for tonumber() with base.
relevance: Relevant, and verified. On Windows 14d8a7a2, tonumber('ffffffffff', 16) gives 4294967295; the branch gives 1099511627775. Linux was already correct. lib_base.c is also patched by 08; no conflict.

subject: FFI: Don't drop signedness in FOLD rule for FLOAD of CNEWI.
relevance: Only FFI produces CNEWI.

subject: macOS: Avoid collision of mcode with xzone malloc reclaim ring.
relevance: Needed for macOS (DESIGN §2). The code is inside #if LJ_TARGET_OSX, so it is inert on Windows and Linux.

subject: iOS: Disable non-functional os.tmpname().
relevance: iOS is not a target, and the sandbox removes os.

subject: FFI/ARM64e: Sign FFI callback pointers.
relevance: None.

subject: Add line number directive. v3.0 backport.
relevance: It adds `#123 "file"` lines. Its context includes the error messages that a2ce8114 added.

subject: Check for IR_NEWREF in IR_ALEN forwarding.
relevance: Relevant, and verified that the bug predates the base. With #1534 reproducer 1, #t gives 0 under JIT and 3 in the interpreter on 14d8a7a2; the branch gives 3. Its context includes `IROp op;` from the deferred 1ee778a4, but git's 3-way merge applied it cleanly, and the loop is identical to upstream.

subject: Don't compile select() indexing beyond varargs.
relevance: Relevant. It removes an int32-overflow-prone guard (frofs+8*idx, idx<<3) for select(n, ...) with n beyond the varargs. Reported upstream as #1535. My probe did not reproduce a wrong result on 14d8a7a2.

subject: x64/LJ_GC64: Avoid s2l fwd stall after stack restore, part 2.
relevance: Performance only; part 1 is the base commit 14d8a7a2. It introduced a register-clobber bug in asm_ahustore that 3a658cac fixes.

subject: x86/x64: Use scratch register for IR_TOBIT and IR_CONV u64.num.
relevance: Relevant: a register-allocation fix in the x64 backend. It is a master-side commit, merged into v2.1 by 47fc4e39.
pick: conflict (trivial): resolved exactly as upstream merge 47fc4e39; asm_tobit/asm_conv identical to upstream

subject: x86/x64: Don't sink IR_CONV num.int with -O-dce.
relevance: Not affected. It only matters with -O-dce, and sandboxed code cannot change JIT options. Taken because it is a no-op under default flags and makes lj_asm.c identical to upstream.

subject: DynASM/ARM64: Prevent sanitizer warning in dasm_encode().
relevance: Fixes UB in buildvm for ARM64 builds. Inert on x64.

subject: x86/x64: Fix for change to avoid s2l fwd stall in stores.
relevance: It fixes only b310887b (the asm_ahustore code that b310887b added).

subject: Don't FOLD ldexp with non-integer exponent.
relevance: Relevant, and verified. On 14d8a7a2 the JIT folds math.ldexp(1, 1e10) to 0 where the interpreter gives inf; the exponents -1e10, 0/0 and 2^31+0.5 also differ. The branch matches the interpreter. math.ldexp is in the sandbox's math library.
